capture: Each row names a recorded native input observation (an index into schema-completeness-native-observations.json with argv), a perturbation at a JSON pointer, and the native verdict. uniqueItemsAgreement rows insert a duplicate item that the published variant refuses with uniqueItems at that pointer and native admission refuses too. residue rows apply a perturbation the published variant admits and native admission refuses; evidence is a refusal literal segment of the named owner contained in the native diagnostic or in the strings the failed report adds.

perturbations.duplicate-item: insert a copy of the first item at index 1
perturbations.unknown-member: add the member x-schema-completeness-residue with value true
perturbations.other-token: append -x-schema-completeness-residue (or use x-schema-completeness-residue for an empty string)

nonClaims: Rows are witnesses that a class is native-owned on a route; they do not enumerate every native-only constraint.
The authoring probe applied every perturbation to every location of every argv observation; only the rows below are committed and re-executed.
